title: ATTP and SETKA-Pro launch regular 3×3 basketball tournaments in Moldova
excerpt: ATTP and SETKA-Pro have launched BSKT CUP 3×3, a permanent series of basketball tournaments in the Olympic format, with more than 100 athletes and qualified referees.
body_html:
The National Sports Association ATTP, in partnership with SETKA-Pro, has launched a new project in the Republic of Moldova dedicated to the development of competitive basketball, organising a permanent series of tournaments in the Olympic 3×3 format recognised by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA). The initiative already brings together more than 100 performance athletes and qualified referees, creating a new platform for competition and recognition for professional Moldovan basketball.

Held under the name BSKT CUP 3×3, the tournaments follow a dynamic format, marked by intense play, a fast pace and the importance of individual and team technical and tactical preparation. The competition system means regular matches between teams, giving participants the chance to use their experience, improve their skills and play in an organised competitive setting.

A distinctive feature of the project is that it is permanent and involves a considerable number of athletes, which allows a busy competition calendar with experienced players and refereeing by qualified officials.

The tournaments aim to promote 3×3 basketball, build an active sports community and create good conditions for participants to stay in competitive shape. At the same time, the project pays particular attention to respecting the rules of the game, sporting discipline, the principles of fair play and the integrity of competition.

3×3 basketball, part of the Olympic programme, is one of the fastest-growing sports internationally thanks to its accessibility, spectacle and compact competition format. Expanding it in the Republic of Moldova gives new opportunities to athletes who want to compete regularly and helps diversify organised sports activity nationally.

The launch of BSKT CUP 3×3 also marks the expansion of the National Sports Association ATTP into new sports, confirming the organisation's focus on long-term competition projects, on developing athletes' potential and on promoting a sporting culture built on performance, responsibility and mutual respect.

Through this project, ATTP and SETKA-Pro aim to build a reference competition platform for 3×3 basketball in the Republic of Moldova, able to offer athletes continuity, professional organisation and new prospects for development.
